title: Vakatendeka vekuMakkah
intro: Mumazuva ekutanga ekuzarurwa, apo shoko rechokwadi raisangana nekupikiswa kwakasimba, mimwe mweya yakamira isingazununguki mukutenda kwayo. Vatendi ava vakatarisana neutsinye husingafungidzike kubva kune avo vaitsvaga kudzima chiedza chekutenda. Kutambudzwa kwavo kwaive kwakanyanya, kutambura kwavo kukuru—asi ndimi dzavo hadzina kumbomira kuzivisa Humwe hwaAllah. Kunyangwe pavakakandwa mugomba rakadzika, dziviriro yaMwari yakavakomberedza, ichishandura muedzo wavo kuita chipupuriro chekutenda chisingaperi. Ngationgororei rwendo rwemweya iyi inoshamisa.
clues: Takaedzwa nechirango chakakomba nekuda kwekuramba kusiya kutenda kwedu muna Mwari Mumwe chete
Vanhu vedu vaisagona kuputsa kutsunga kwedu, zvisinei nekuti hutsinye hwavo hwakava hwekugadzira sei
Taimiswa patsime masikati, asi rubatsiro rwaMwari rwaigara ruri pedyo
Kutsungirira kwedu kwakashamisa kunyange avo vakaona kutsungirira kwedu
Vazhinji muMakkah vakaedza kutimanikidza kuti tisiye chitendero chedu, asi takaramba takatsunga
Zvose pazvairatidzika kunge zvakarasika, rusununguko rwedu rwakasvika kuburikidza nekupindira kunoshamisa kwaMwari
